== Description ==
English [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]], a [[Decipher]] foil box topper for [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]]. The card is in a PSA holder, certification 79950734.
